milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The cyan_wall_banner is on the west wall of the north corridor at spawn-relative (-2, 2, -4) facing east. max_distance=5 requires the player to actually enter the north corridor rather than just turning at spawn (banner is ~4.5 blocks from spawn). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the banner.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The granite_slab path is on the east corridor floor at spawn-relative x=4-7, y=0, z=0. Target is center of path at (5, 0, 0), which is 5 blocks from spawn. max_distance=5 requires entering the east corridor. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the slabs.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The powered_rail tracks are on the west corridor floor at spawn-relative x=-4 to -6, y=0, z=0. Target is center rail at (-5, 0, 0), which is 5 blocks from spawn. max_distance=5 requires entering the west corridor. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the rails.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The purple_bed foot is at spawn-relative (-3, 0, -11) in the NW bedroom, approximately 11.4 blocks from spawn. max_distance=6 requires navigating through the north corridor and entering the bedroom. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the bed.

Uses inventory_has because mining a bed in Minecraft drops the bed item into the player's inventory. Beds can be broken by hand (no tool required) and always drop as an item. The player starts with no purple_bed in inventory, so having 1 confirms successful mining.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The potted_lily_of_the_valley is on an oak_planks nightstand at spawn-relative (4, 1, -12) in the NE bedroom, approximately 12.6 blocks from spawn. max_distance=6 requires navigating through the north corridor into the NE bedroom. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the pot.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The light_blue_stained_glass_pane windows are on the far wall of the east room at spawn-relative (12, 1, 0), approximately 12 blocks from spawn. max_distance=6 requires navigating through the east corridor and entering the east room. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the panes.

Uses inventory_has because mining a bed in Minecraft drops the bed item into the player's inventory. Beds can be broken by hand (no tool required). The player starts with no light_blue_bed in inventory, so having 1 confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has because mining nether_brick_stairs with a pickaxe drops the item into the player's inventory. The player is given a wooden_pickaxe via /give command to enable this. Without a pickaxe, nether_brick_stairs drop nothing. The player starts with no nether_brick_stairs in inventory, so having 1 confirms successful mining with the pickaxe.

Uses inventory_has because crafting purple_dye (shapeless recipe: red_dye + blue_dye) places the result in the player's inventory. The player starts with NO purple_dye; materials (red_dye + blue_dye) are in a chest in the purple_bed room at (-4, 0, -11), requiring navigation to obtain them. Having 1 purple_dye confirms successful crafting.
